feeds.title: Verra Mobility
feeds.description: Verra Mobility is committed to developing and using the latest in technology and data intelligence to help make transportation safer and easier. As a global company, Verra Mobility sits at the center of the mobility ecosystem. A leading provider of connected systems, Verra Mobility processes millions of transactions each year through connectivity.

feeds.title: Arity
feeds.description: Arity is a technology company focused on making transportation smarter, safer, and more useful. We transform massive amounts of data into actionable insights to help partners better predict risk and make smarter decisions in real time. Read their blog to uncover mobility insights and company news.

feeds.title: Urban Air Mobility
feeds.description: Urban Air Mobility For more than 30 years has specialized in delivering highly complex technical and industrial aerospace information and advice to a wide number of government and industry clients. They provide a round-up of urban air mobility stories from around the world. Head to their blog to read about them in their work along with helpful informative articles.

feeds.title: EVE Air Mobility
feeds.description: Eve is a new independent company founded by Embraer dedicated to accelerating the Urban Air Mobility (UAM) ecosystem. Eve is taking a holistic approach to progressing the UAM ecosystem with an advanced electric vertical takeoff and landing vehicle (eVTOL), comprehensive global services and support network, and a unique air traffic management solution.

feeds.title: Tactile Mobility Blog
feeds.description: Tactile Mobility's multidisciplinary team of innovators has been passionately honing the missing sense for superior driving, since 2012. With a presence in the U.S., Germany, and Israel, we apply our vast experience in signal processing, AI, big data analysis, embedded computing, and more, to transform the mobility industry.

feeds.title: E-Motec
feeds.description: A publication giving you insights behind the technology progressing the new era of clean sustainable mobility. Discover brand new solutions to new challenges, and meet the industry innovators pushing boundaries to make E-mobility a reality.

feeds.title: Electrive
feeds.description: In a nutshell, electrive.com is a news servicefor decision-makers in the electric mobility industry. The industry-facing website builds on the email briefing we publish every workday since 2013. Our mail-out and online service covera wide range of relevant stories and developments in electric transport across Europe and beyond.

feeds.title: Pendel Blog
feeds.description: Pendel provide autonomous transport solutions as a service for public authorities and private sites. Just like a pendulum, they are connecting the two sides; technology and use cases; clients and providers. Read their blogs to stay updated about news and trends.

feeds.title: May Mobility
feeds.description: May Mobility is a company committed to transforming cities through autonomous vehicle technology. They aim to create a safer, greener, and more accessible world by developing autonomous micro transit services that work with communities to bridge transportation gaps. May Mobility is not just another taxi service, but rather a company that is using autonomous technology to solve some of the biggest challenges facing cities today. - Discover the latest press releases and posts from May Mobility. Learn about our latest news, technology, company culture and more though their blog
